records.jp: はぁっ、はぁっ……みんな、無事！？
ちょ、すごい音がしたけど！？　大丈夫！？
records.en_original: We heard a huge noise! Are you guys all right?!
records.en_auxiliary: We heard a huge noise! Are you guys all right?!
records.en: We heard an incredible noise! Is everyone all right?!

records.jp: 陽桜莉っ！　中で何があったの……！？
大きく感情が揺さぶられた影響で……<CR>世界の維持が不安定になった
records.en_original: The disturbance of emotions seems to have destabilized the world.
records.en_auxiliary: The disturbance of emotions seems to have destabilized the world.
records.en: The intense fluctuation in emotion...<CR>has destabilized the world.

records.jp: （私の……せい？　私が、詩さんの記憶を<CR>取り戻そうなんて言ったから……？）
records.en_original: (Is this...my fault? Is this because I insisted we help Uta regain her memories?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Is this...my fault? Is this because I insisted we help Uta regain her memories?)
records.en: (Is this... my fault? Because I said we<CR>should recover Uta-san's memories...?)

records.jp: 私たちの世界が……壊される……！
records.en_original: It's going to destroy this world!
records.en_auxiliary: It's going to destroy this world!
records.en: Our world... is going to be destroyed...!

records.jp: （……ダメだ、ダメだダメだダメだ！<CR>落ち込むのは後にしろ、愛央……！）
records.en_original: (No! Snap out of it! This is not the time to get down!)
records.en_auxiliary: (No! Snap out of it! This is not the time to get down!)
records.en: (...No. No, no, no!<CR>Save the despair for later, Ao...!)

records.jp: （折れちゃいけない！<CR>ここで私が下を向いちゃいけないんだ……！）
records.en_original: (I won't give up! I have to keep my chin up!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I won't give up! I have to keep my chin up!)
records.en: (I cannot break!<CR>I cannot be the one looking down now...!)

records.jp: みんな！！<CR>混乱してるのは分かる。こうなった責任は私にある！
records.en_original: Listen! I know that things are crazy right now, and it's partly my fault.
records.en_auxiliary: Listen! I know that things are crazy right now, and it's partly my fault.
records.en: Everyone!!<CR>I know you are confused. I am responsible for what happened!

records.jp: でも今は――お願い、一緒に戦って！<CR>私たちの世界を守って！！
records.en_original: But please! Help me fight! Help me protect this world!
records.en_auxiliary: But please! Help me fight! Help me protect this world!
records.en: But right now—please, fight with me!<CR>Protect our world!!

records.jp: ……そうだよ。アレをどうにかしないと、<CR>私たちの世界は確実に壊れる……！
records.en_original: That's right. If we don't do something, Oasis is done for.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. If we don't do something, Oasis is done for.
records.en: ...That is right. If we do not deal with that thing,<CR>our world will certainly be destroyed...!

records.jp: 戦う……それ以外に私たちが生き残る道はない！<CR>そうでしょ、みんな！！
records.en_original: We have to fight. If we don't, we die! Isn't that right, everybody?!
records.en_auxiliary: We have to fight. If we don't, we die! Isn't that right, everybody?!
records.en: We have to fight... It is the only way we can survive!<CR>Right, everyone?!

records.jp: （合ってた間違ってたは今考えることじゃない！<CR>反省も後悔も後でたくさんすればいい！）
records.en_original: (Now's not the time to think about who's right and who's wrong! We can worry about all that later!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Now's not the time to think about who's right and who's wrong! We can worry about all that later!)
records.en: (This is not the time to decide whether I was right or wrong!<CR>I can reflect and regret it as much as I want later!)
